description: 2 tactical challenges for White against the Marshall Attack. Meet 8...d5 with precise central play and defuse Black's initiative.

drills.briefExplanation: 8.c3 d5 9.exd5 Nxd5 10.Nxe5 Nf4 11.Qf3 — take the pawn, return it, and consolidate the center.
drills.description: White to play. Black has castled and you sense the Marshall coming — play 8.c3 and meet 8...d5 correctly.
drills.explanation: 8.c3 is the anti-Marshall waiting move: it prepares d4 and meets 8...d5 with 9.exd5 Nxd5. After 10.Nxe5 Nf4 White must stay calm — 11.Qf3 defends everything at once, attacking f4 and eyeing f7. The point: White gives the pawn back on White's terms and keeps the safer king.
drills.name: Meeting the Gambit

drills.briefExplanation: 10.Nxe5 Nf4 11.Qf3 Bd6 12.g3 — challenge the knight at once and blunt the bishop.
drills.description: White to play. The gambit is on the board after 9...Nxd5 — grab on e5 and defuse the Nf4 jump.
drills.explanation: 10.Nxe5 accepts the challenge, and after 10...Nf4 the move 11.Qf3! is White's best defense — it defends f2, attacks the knight, and prepares d4. After 11...Bd6 12.g3 the knight must retreat and Black's attack loses its sting; White's extra central pawn and safer structure take over.
drills.name: Defusing the Center

name: Marshall Attack — White Tactics
